pairing.title: Connect this kiosk
pairing.prompt: Enter the eight-digit pairing code from the admin panel
pairing.scanHint: The scanner is already on — you can scan the code at any time
pairing.scanWaitingHint: Point the scanner at the barcode in the admin panel
pairing.scanRejected: Not a pairing code: eight digits are required
pairing.binding: Binding the device… downloading settings and operators
pairing.invalidCode: The code is wrong, expired, or there have been too many attempts. Get a new code from the admin panel.
pairing.connectionFailed: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
pairing.badBundle: The server sent unusable data. Ask the administrator for a new code.

idle.title: Take products for yourself
idle.subtitle: Checkout and payment happen at the administrator's till
idle.hint: The QR code is on the back of your badge. Hold it up to the scanner below the screen, then scan the marking codes on the bottles.
idle.badgeUnknown: Badge not recognised. Scan it again, or ask an administrator.
idle.notABadge: Scan your badge first — the kiosk will take the bottles' marking codes after that.

scannerSetup.title: Scanner setup
scannerSetup.transportKeyboardHint: Works on any device: the scanner types the code as if it were a keyboard.
scannerSetup.transportSerialHint: More reliable: the GS separator inside a marking code survives.
scannerSetup.serialNotGranted: No port was chosen, so the kiosk stayed in keyboard mode. Tap Web Serial again and pick the scanner's COM port in the browser dialog.
scannerSetup.transportSerialUnavailable: Web Serial is not available on this device, so only the keyboard mode is offered.
scannerSetup.testPrompt: Scan any code — the kiosk will show what it recognised.
scannerSetup.resultIncomplete: A marking code without the GS separator — the scanner dropped it. Switch to Web Serial.
scannerSetup.resultIncompleteNoSerial: A marking code without the GS separator — the scanner dropped it. Web Serial is not available on this device, so turn on GS separator output (FNC1) in the scanner's own settings.
scannerSetup.gatePrompt: Scan your badge, or enter your personnel number and PIN.
scannerSetup.gateError: Could not sign in. Check the personnel number and the PIN.
scannerSetup.gateRecovery: Can't sign in? Unbind this kiosk in the admin panel and pair it again with a new code — until it is paired, scanner setup opens without a sign-in.
